Field-billing split branch ROUNDs each invoice_share independently without reconciling to the invoice total (penny drift). Assign remainder to largest share. Low blast radius (0 split invoices live). ENRICHED cycle 2 (Codex-confirmed REAL): the deeper issue is the header reconciliation `UPDATE invoices SET total_amount_cents = v_share_total` is gated ONLY behind `IF v_has_price_override` — so on the NON-override path v_share_total is discarded entirely and the header stays at total_price_cents while shares may not even sum to 100 (avg_split_pct is acres-weighted, no sum-to-100 CHECK on field_billing_defaults; 4 fbd rows already live). Fix: move the reconcile UPDATE out of the override guard (always set header = sum of inserted shares) + largest-remainder the pennies.

field_application invoices editable via generic InvoiceDetail -> save_invoice desyncs the field-app split tables. Fix is frontend-only (route field_application rows to /invoices/field-app/:id) BUT this exact segregation is being comprehensively reworked on feat/as-applied-invoices — PARK to avoid a merge collision rather than partial-fix on main. CYCLE-3 RE-CONFIRM (dedupeKey lifecycle:field_application:generic-editor-bypass; verifier MEDIUM): grounded on OUR branch HEAD 3b20d4d6 — Invoices.tsx:682 `navigate(\`/invoices/${row.id}\`)` routes EVERY row to the generic InvoiceDetail; App.tsx:184-185 has the correct /invoices/field-app/:id editor; InvoiceDetail.tsx has NO field_application redirect/read-only guard (grep returns only the <option value="field_application">) and editable=isNew||['draft','unposted'].includes(status) so a draft/unposted field-app invoice is fully editable; handleSave->save_invoice. Live save_invoice (pg_get_functiondef): DELETE invoice_items + re-insert only generic cols (no is_application_fee/price_source/quoted_price_cents), recompute total_amount_cents ONLY (total_cost_cents left stale -> wrong margin in get_sales_detail_report), never re-derives field_app_locations/field_app_location_shares/invoice_shares; for a grouped multi-customer split it edits ONE invoice leaving siblings inconsistent; the type <select> (InvoiceDetail.tsx:996-1000) even lets the user reassign invoice_type away from field_application. ENRICHMENT, same root defect + same fix surface — NOT a new finding. STILL PARKED: (a) feat/as-applied-invoices reworks this whole area (FieldInvoices.tsx + routing 4dfdf7ed, neither on this branch) -> merge-collision risk; (b) the naive 'route ALL field_application to field-app editor' is PARTIALLY WRONG — blend-ticket-backed field-app invoices (job_id NULL, blend_ticket_id set) intentionally use the generic editor; the correct fix redirects only engine-built ones. Latent (0 field_application invoices live).

create_quick_delivery validates inventory per-line independently, so duplicate product lines in one call can over-prebook. Aggregate by product_id before the net-available check. Defense-in-depth (UI already dedupes).
Re-bill guard only blocks payment_status='billed'; a ticket manually set to 'prepaid'/'no_charge' can still generate a second invoice. Widen guard to allow billing only from 'unbilled'.

NEW cycle 2 (Codex-confirmed REAL, MEDIUM — agrees with Claude verifier). save_field_app_invoice group-edit branch reads status with a PLAIN unlocked SELECT (no FOR UPDATE), checks status once, then unconditionally DELETEs+rewrites invoice_items/invoice_shares/field_app_locations for the whole group; its later `UPDATE invoices SET total_amount_cents` has no `WHERE status IN(...)` recheck. post_invoice/post_invoice_group both lock FOR UPDATE first. Race: a concurrent edit can rewrite the line items/total of an invoice a concurrent post just flipped to 'posted' -> POSTED doc diverged from financial_audit_log 'invoice_posted' + generate_rup_sales_records. Latent (0 field_application invoices, 0 posted invoices live). FIX: lock first — `PERFORM 1 FROM invoices WHERE (id=p_invoice_id OR invoice_group_id=v_existing_group_id) FOR UPDATE;` and re-read status under the lock (mirror post_invoice_group). Migration. Evidence: 20260616191740_blend_and_fieldapp_invoice_audit_rows.sql (save_field_app_invoice edit branch ~L500/L517/L823); post FOR UPDATE in 20260614144252_pricing_status_columns_and_post_gate.sql:59/116.

Evidence: 20260616191740_...audit_rows.sql orphan loop ~L560/L568 vs creation audit ~L832; void_invoice ref 20260529214538_...status_transitions.sql:291.
